limitations: Question holdout on already observed validation images, not blind images or patient-independent evidence.
Conditional mechanism panel selected by answer-free compatibility; report 18/96 coverage rather than full-benchmark applicability.
Train annotations and reference crops are an evidence-card prototype, not independently verified clinical procedures.
Strict exact match remains sensitive to expression; no retrospective scoring change.
Two inference-engine initializations are not independent training seeds.
Hidden-answer mismatch grouping is evaluation-only; no query gold enters retrieval or prompts.
Matching a hidden source answer measures behavioral concordance; for binary mismatched labels it can simply equal the error count and does not establish copying causally.
